newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE TO AUCTION 125BLN DRACS OF 7-YR FRNS JUL 29.
newsitem.headline: GREECE TO AUCTION 125BLN DRACS OF 7-YR FRNS JUL 29.

text.p: Greece will auction 125 billion drachmas of seven-year floaters on July 29 and set the first coupon at 10.40 percent, the finance ministry said in a statement.
The first coupon is based on the 12-month T-bill rate, currently at 9.60 percent, plus a spread of 0.80 percent.
The ministry has the right to accept non-competitive bids up to 30 percent of the auctioned amount, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
